chunks: Whatever is in Hā from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from their father ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, an immediate transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى: a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ: a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ: the originating narrator referenced in this chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly reliability of the hadith source.
